items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I talked to Harold Aland and I talked to Will Foger.

ctx.x: It was written for this lady and she was there too. It‟s amazing to find out [unintelligible] check these things out. I‟m not talking about sending somebody a ghostly whisper but I talked to Harold Aland and I talked to Will Foger.
Right, and they say that, sure.
